title: On shifting the thermal explosion threshold by a vortical flow in dimension two
summary: This paper is concerned with a study of a natural generalization of a classical Frank-Kamenetskii model of thermal explosion in the presence of a vortical flow in a two dimensional setting. This model describes possible stationary temperature distributions in a combustion vessel which boundary is maintained at a constant temperature. The model constitutes a Dirichlet boundary value problem for a certain semi-linear elliptic equation that depends on a parameter $λ,$ called Frank-Kamenetskii parameter.
